C4_local_tilt_probe.note: Combined ±1 degree roll/pitch already exceeds C4 2.5 inch height-difference condition before heave. Not a full-travel boarding approval.

sidebearer.required_material_curve_status: Unselected. CAD procurement target20 mm compression; geometry needs17.67 mm at2 degree relative roll before tolerance. Neither stroke,1000 N/mm nor fatigue/strain/friction is a vendor rating.
sidebearer.window_limitations: Only separate ideal inequalities: h1.5m local stability versus opposed±40 mm banks with centered CG/no lateral acceleration. These do not establish a common permitted operating envelope.

load_sharing.guide_assumption: Ideal frictionless boxes follow frame orientation; each pair has equal deflection, so 2k/box. Spherical bearing accepts axle tilt. No validation of actual guides/seals/abutments or lateral/brake restraint.
